title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2605.15250v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decoding efficiency depends on KV-cache traffic, computation, and parallelism. Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) offers absorbed and head-expanded forms, but its head-specific projections limit grouped KV sharing. We introduce Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA), whose group-shared up-projections preserve a joint latent and enable a shardable expanded cache. The same weights support equivalent MQA-absorb and GQA execution using existing kernels. Roofline analysis relates path preference to GPU compute-to-bandwidth ratio and tensor parallelism (TP): absorption trades traffic for computation and replicates the latent across ranks; GQA shards KV groups. Pretraining with eight query heads per group yields terminal training losses close to MLA's across the tested model scales at matched tokens. TransGQLA converts GQA and MLA checkpoints using calibration data. Without gradient updates, converted DeepSeek-V3.1-Base achieves 77.79% eight-ta

translated_title: GQLA：面向硬件自适应解码的分组查询潜在注意力
translated_abstract: 解码效率取决于KV缓存流量、计算量与并行度。多头潜在注意力（MLA）提供了吸收式和头扩展式两种执行形式，但其针对特定头的投影限制了分组KV共享。我们提出了分组查询潜在注意力（GQLA），其组共享的上投影保留了联合潜在表示，并支持可分片的扩展缓存。相同权重可借助现有内核实现等效的MQA吸收式与GQA两种执行方式。屋顶线分析将路径偏好与GPU的计算带宽比及张量并行（TP）程度关联起来：吸收式以流量换计算并在各并行副本间复制潜在表示；GQA则对KV组进行分片。在匹配token数量下，每组采用八个查询头的预训练在所测试的各模型规模上均取得了接近MLA的最终训练损失。TransGQLA可利用校准数据转换GQA和MLA检查点，无需梯度更新，转换后的DeepSeek-V3.1-Base在八项任务上达到了77.79%的（成绩，原文截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出分组查询潜在注意力（GQLA），通过组共享投影使同一权重即可支持MQA吸收式与GQA两种解码路径，从而根据GPU计算带宽比和张量并行度自适应选择最优推理方式，并能零梯度转换现有MLA/GQA模型检查点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA), whose group-shared up-projections allow the same weights to support both MQA-absorb and GQA decoding paths, enabling hardware-adaptive inference based on GPU compute-to-bandwidth ratio and tensor parallelism, with gradient-free conversion of existing MLA/GQA checkpoints.
